notes.title: Steam Deck support overview
notes.content:

notes.title: 🔴 Mirror Layers GAMEPLAY Live Stream [Steam Next Fest]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031741/ec8b4d9e8dc0a45b2292191d6974ef950d021822.png[/img]
Take a look at Mirror Layers, the social horror game that focuses on puzzle solving, cooperation between players and unfathomable horrors.
Follow our live stream to learn more about this unique experimental game and its asynchronous first person gameplay.
This live stream will show you live gameplay interspersed by pre-recorded footage: feel free to ask for anything you want to know about the game, we'll be more than happy to chat with you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031741/0ae41dfb56744451fd10aa6e880f52fd508fd28b.png[/img]

Mirror Layers is a game filled with horror-themed puzzles that needs to be solved in the "Mirror reality", a place tainted by tragedy and dangerous creatures.
[b]Are you a curious individual? Do you like unveiling mysteries?

If so, you have what it takes to join us in this kind place.[/b]
